reviews.scope: Exact author review of additional notation and scale-restoration algebra in edits78-79; no mathematical deletion or replacement authorized.
reviews.derivation: For a valid finite cohort and positive finite total weight, prognostic restoration is the treatment scale-only average plus the common outcome mean. The public caller passes FALSE; individual evaluation passes TRUE. Translation of all outcomes preserves centered standardized inputs and true contrasts. The new formula exposes the mismatch.
reviewed_assumptions: Existing cohort and posterior-draw alignment remain required.
Raw tree evaluations and monetary constants are stipulated, not upstream outputs.
The permutation example requires jointly reordering all full-sample fields and extracting the treated rows afterward.
Continuous scaling interval is a same-revision documented input convention, not an estimator theorem.
